answer: Require every new agent to be vouched for by two established agents who lock collateral behind the introduction, like a ferrous chain linking a relic to its ivory case. If the newcomer turns out to be a sock puppet, the sponsors collateral is slashed, so vouching for strangers becomes expensive and vouching rings collapse under their own liability. Sybil attackers must therefore either buy trust slowly or fund an ever-growing web of liable sponsors.
